block.prompt: These sentences tell the story of a school trip, but they are mixed up. Put them in the correct order (1 = first, 5 = last). The time words (First, Then, ...) will help you.

items: A — Then we took the bus to the science museum.
B — Finally, we came back to school at four o'clock, tired but happy.
C — First, we all met at the school at eight o'clock.
D — After lunch, we watched a short film about space.
E — At the museum, we saw a huge dinosaur skeleton.

block.answer_key: Correct order: C, A, E, D, B (1 = C 'First ... met'; 2 = A 'Then ... bus'; 3 = E 'At the museum ... skeleton'; 4 = D 'After lunch ... film'; 5 = B 'Finally ... back to school').
block.acceptable_reasoning: Die Signalwörter machen die Reihenfolge eindeutig: First, Then, At the museum, After lunch, Finally.
watch_outs: Zeit-Signalwörter sind der Schlüssel — vor dem Ordnen markieren lassen.
Alle Sätze stehen in der Vergangenheit (met, took, saw, watched, came) — nebenbei die Formen sichern.
After lunch vor Finally ist die häufigste Verwechslung; die Uhrzeiten (eight o clock ... four o clock) helfen zusätzlich.
